note: L'atelier des mesures: loft room over the dye room (east half), camera facing north. Lemon-primrose plaster between pale grey roof beams, pale grey-washed boards, skylight and two paint-ringed portholes; landmark = the giant wooden ruler post and the stepped stack of wooden solids. Feminine nouns on the left (la grandeur, la tonne, l'épaisseur, la résolution); masculine on the right (le géant, le foudre, le carreau); adjectives régulier and carré in the centre. Blue door on the left (west) opens on the lavender frame room (R_shapes_03); the stairwell on the right goes DOWN to the dye room (R_colors_02). Zone z1 = the measuring workbench on the right wall.
